scope: CDFs of per-user observed maxima. Thresholds count users with every observed packet at or below the threshold. Finite observations, not a latency guarantee; intended-send includes generator backlog.

p99_sample_scope.note: Nearest-rank p99 selects the observed maximum with 1..99 samples; histogram p99 bounds must cover that maximum. Finite observations do not establish a long-term percentile.

measurement_start: The legacy send_to_receive field starts at the source client timestamp, which can precede socket send; it is not an isolated server-hop duration.
